Overstory, midstory, and understory remain spatially separate across the forest depth.
A standing dead snag is visibly distinct from shadowed or leafless live trunks.
A large fallen log has credible scale and physical contact with the forest floor.
Uniform plantation rows, generic lushness, or a single giant tree do not substitute for the complete structure.
